name: Carlo Ahead | Musikcaféen
description:
With roots in the Nørrebro-Collective, Struglatz, his colourful language and his plethora of technical energy has made Mund de Carlo both a unique and persistent voice on the Danish rap scene.

Ahead is an instrumental hip-hop quartet (drums, bass, keys, guitar) that always delivers a show full of life. Inspired by hip-hop traditions from Detroit, New York and L.A., the expression soars from the flying and spherical to the progressive and hard-hitting, and from jazzy coffee loops to dynamic breakbeats. It's him Matias on the drums, Sebastian on the bass, Andreas on the keys, Glen on the guitar and Carlo on the mic. Come along and be hit by something!

See you!

name: kendall lujan (US)
description:
Portland, Oregon based artist, kendall lujan embarks on her first full length album “Lucky Penny’ it is set to be released Fall 2024. After releasing her Debut self titled EP last Spring, featured on official playlist for Spotify and Apple Music. Lujan also gaining attention from NPR’s Tiny Desk, MTV and winning the John Lennon Songwriting contest. Sharing the stage with Amos Lee, Frazey Ford (of The Be Good Tanyas), Allie Crow Buckley, Early James, and The Magnetic Fields. ‘Lucky Penny’ features many genres including Jazz, Folk, Bosa Nova and Indie-Rock. The natural singer and songwriter put together a studio band with Micah Hummel (drums), Colin Schmidt (bass) and Alex Milsted (piano) and recorded at the Map Room Studio in Portland, Oregon with Dominik Schmidt producing.

Her writing is real, introspective and reflective. After touring the songs in Europe twice this past Fall lujan is ready to show her versatility and growth as an artist.

The first single to be released late March 2024 titled ‘Goodbyes’. The song explores mourning and loss of important people in your world. In the sense of ending romantic relationships it explores the process of knowing when someone isn’t suited for your life or growth any longer. Lujan writes “I wrote this song to remind myself that even though things are hard you will meet those people who stick around eventually.” Even though people come and go in your world, remembering that there will be lots of cries and laughs on your journey to finding those people who see you for who you are. The main hook stating: ‘it takes a lot of goodbyes to get to forever.

name: Mød Twiggy: Film & talk
description:
🌟Kom helt tæt på verdens første it-girl og modeikon – når selveste Twiggy gæster Bremen Teater d. 25 marts.

Dokumentaren 'Twiggy' får dansk premiere på dette års CPH:DOX. I den anledning inviterer vi til en uforglemmelig aften i modeikonets tegn. Efter visningen af filmen deltager Twiggy og filmens instruktør Sadie Frost, i en samtale om filmen. Her får publikum en unik mulighed for at høre hendes egne beretninger og perspektiver om et liv, der har været definerende for mode- og popkulturen.

Køb billetter her:  https://cphdox.dk/meet-twiggy-and-warren-ellis-at-cphdox-2025/

Program: 
19.00: Dørene åbner
20.00: Filmvisning: 'Twiggy', efterfulgt af samtale med Twiggy & instruktør Sadie Frost.

Billetpris: 150 kr. + gebyr

Om filmen: 
For første gang nogensinde fortæller Twiggy – verdens første it-girl – sin egen historie. I den personlige og stjernebestrøede dokumentar TWIGGY, der får Danmarkspremiere på CPH:DOX 2025, får publikum historien om den spinkle og androgyne kvinde, der blev en verdenssensation og transformerede 60’ernes modeideal. Dokumentarfilmen er instrueret af Sadie Frost, og foruden Twiggy selv medvirker bl.a. Dustin Hoffmann, Brooke Shields og Paul McCartney

name: Mød Warren Ellis: Film, talk & minikoncert
description:
🎻 Den legendariske multi-instrumentalist og Nick Cave-samarbejdspartner, Warren Ellis, gæster d. 26 marts Bremen Teater.
Efter visningen af dokumentaren ‘Ellis Park’, deltager Ellis i en samtale om filmens tematikker og som prikken over i’et afsluttes aftenen med en intim mini-koncert, hvor Ellis’ ikoniske violin spiller hovedrollen.⁠

Køb billetter her: https://cphdox.dk/meet-twiggy-and-warren-ellis-at-cphdox.../

Program: 
19.30: Dørene åbner
20.30: Filmvisning: 'Ellis Park ', efterfulgt af talk og minikoncert med Warren Ellis.

Billetpris: 185 kr. + gebyr

Om filmen:
Multiinstrumentalisten Warren Ellis har sat sit præg på musikscenen gennem de sidste tre årtier, både for sig selv, som medlem af bandet The Dirty Three og som Nick Caves faste samarbejdspartner. Men langt fra de verdenskendte festivalscener og koncerthuse har han lagt sin passion i et ganske andet projekt, der portrætteres i dokumentaren ELLIS PARK. Sammen med dyreaktivisten Femke den Haas har han skabt et dyrereservat dybt inde i Sumatras jungle, hvor de redder og hjælper mishandlede dyr.

name: Poetry Takeover 2025: An open mic series by Red Door
description:
POETRY TAKEOVER
Bi-Monthly Open Mic by RED DOOR
at La Fee Verte - H.C Ørsteds Vej 6, Frederiksberg

FREE EVENT!

"Poetry Takeover" is a bi-monthly open mic event by Red Door and its project The Poetic Phonotheque, held at La Fee Verte, an absinthe bar known for its unique ambiance and focus on music and poetic encounters. 

The event provides a platform for both emerging and established poets to share their work in a relaxed, creative setting, so bring your latest writing, positive feedback is encouraged!

We welcome participants in all languages and often feature guest hosts and renowned writers. The evening is open to anyone who wishes to read, with sign-up available upon arrival. 3-4 min per round of reading per person, but we do several rounds.

If you don't want to read but enjoy poetry, you're welcome to come and enjoy!

Event Details:

When: Every two months (last Thursday)
Where: La Fee Verte
Cost: Free to attend and participate, drinks available at the bar
Format: Open mic (sign up upon arrival)

Whether you are here to read or listen, we invite you to join us for an evening of poetry in a welcoming, creative, welcoming environment. 

If you're not in Copenhagen but would like to share your poetry with us, send it to poeticphonotheque.com, our international multimedia archive of poetry.

Special thanks to La Fee Verte for this ongoing collaboration.

We welcome participants in all languages and often feature guest hosts and renowned writers. The evening is open to anyone who wishes to read, with sign-up available upon arrival. 3-4 min per round of reading per person, but we do several rounds.

If you don't want to read but enjoy poetry, you're welcome to come and enjoy!

Event Details:

When: Every two months (last Thursday)
Where: La Fee Verte
Cost: Free to attend and participate, drinks available at the bar
Format: Open mic (sign up upon arrival)

Whether you are here to read or listen, we invite you to join us for an evening of poetry in a welcoming, creative, welcoming environment. 

If you're not in Copenhagen but would like to share your poetry with us, send it to poeticphonotheque.com, our international multimedia archive of poetry.

Special thanks to La Fee Verte for this ongoing collaboration.
